kgaidev-kgai-knowledge-graph.description: Records and retrieves engineering decisions in the kgai knowledge graph (a small, stable graph of domain ELEMENTS — Invoice, Pricing, Checkout… — shaped by an immutable log of DECISIONS). INVOKE THIS SKILL AUTOMATICALLY, WITHOUT WAITING TO BE ASKED, WHENEVER you make or implement a structural/architectural choice: splitting, merging, or moving a module/feature; renaming a domain element (its canonical name changes — code-level renames of files/functions don't count); changing a dependency, ownership boundary, or how something is exposed/rendered; deprecating or replacing a prior decision; or…
